sentences.sentence: A witch quietly created a magic mirror in a cave.
The magic mirror constantly tricked anyone who played with it.
When someone played with the magic mirror, it would change how things looked.
The magic mirror brought sadness to people all over the village.
The witch laughed loudly when she saw people using the magic mirror.
People were extremely angry that the witch created the magic mirror.
Finally, someone broke the spell by crying pure tears.
People were unbelievably happy when the spell was broken.
